subject: Geography
source_note: TIE (2023), Geography Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the structure of the Earth

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the origin and the structure of the Earth and earth systems
competences: (a) Describe the internal structure of the Earth (crust, mantle, core) and their major characteristics (location, size/ thickness, density and gross composition)
(b) Describe the main external Earth systems (Hydrosphere, Atmosphere and Biosphere)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the internal structure of the Earth (crust, mantle, core) and their major characteristics (location, size/ thickness, density and gross composition)
objectives.resources: Relevant books, globe/models, environment, and flash with content on internal structure of the earth
objectives.assessment_criteria: The internal structure of the Earth is correctly described

objectives.text: (b) Describe the main external Earth systems (Hydrosphere, Atmosphere and Biosphere)
objectives.teaching_methods: Questions &Answers, Field observation, Independent library study
objectives.resources: Relevant books, globe/models, environment, and relevant ICT tools, flash with content on external structure of the earth (atmosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere and cryosphere)
objectives.assessment_criteria: The external structure of the Earth is correctly described

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic skills and techniques in Geography

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the basic techniques of map and photograph interpretation
competences: (a) Describe the basic principles of reading and interpreting maps (key, symbols, direction, margin/frame, map title, scale and contour patterns) (b) Reading and interpreting various type of maps and their importance (topographical and statistical map)
(b) Describe the basic concept of photograph in Geography (meaning, types, elements and uses)
(c) Describe the basic principles of photograph interpretation (identifying foreground, middle ground and background, associating objects with geographical phenomena)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the basic principles of reading and interpreting maps (key, symbols, direction, margin/frame, map title, scale and contour patterns) (b) Reading and interpreting various type of maps and their importance (topographical and statistical map)
objectives.resources: Maps, relevant books, and relevant ICT simulation tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic principles of reading and interpretation of maps are clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Describe the basic concept of photograph in Geography (meaning, types, elements and uses)
objectives.resources: Relevant books and photographs (ground, vertical and oblique), magazine/ newspapers, camera, and relevant ICT tools)
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of photograph and its contents are clearly explained

objectives.text: (c) Describe the basic principles of photograph interpretation (identifying foreground, middle ground and background, associating objects with geographical phenomena)
objectives.resources: Relevant books on photographs, photographs (ground, vertical and oblique), magazine/ newspapers, and relevant ICT tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic principles of interpretation of photography are clearly described
